description_en: Uploads a PCA certificate to a certificate warehouse
description_zh: 本接口一般用于在证书仓库中上传PCA证书
name: UploadPCACert

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the certificate warehouse.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh:
仓库ID。
此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html获取
parameters.name: warehouse_id

parameters.help_en: The content of the certificate and its chain, in PEM format
parameters.name: cert

parameters.help_en: The private key of the certificate, in PEM format
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en: A custom name for the certificate
parameters.name: name
